tokenizer: Existing pinned Kuromoji ipadic0.9.0; no dictionary or tokenizer changes
script_conversion: API29+ public Android ICU Hiragana-Katakana; Katakana-Latin, one conversion per context-preserving kana group
selection: Native kana pronunciation, otherwise native kana reading. No expected phrase overrides and no guessed unknown reading.
grouping: Join adjacent tokens when previous kana ends in small tsu or next begins with vowel-length mark.
Join auxiliary verbs and nonindependent/suffix verbs/adjectives with a preceding predicate; attach connective particles to that predicate.
Join noun suffixes and a following token after native prefix POS. Other native words get external spaces.
No transformations across punctuation, whitespace, protected literals or unresolved tokens.
literal_rules: Backtick code spans are opaque exact text, including Japanese inside code.

Broad URI/IRI, email and handle spans are opaque; trim only sentence punctuation and unmatched closing brackets. Undelimited Japanese inside noncode identifier makes full reading unavailable: never infer identifier end from grammatical-looking suffix.
Contiguous non-Japanese token runs preserve original names, times, number/currency punctuation and accents. Insert spaces outside neighboring word/literal units, never inside opaque runs.
full_reading_abstentions: Blank or >16384UTF16 input; API<29 explicitly unsupported.
Unresolved Japanese script outside protected code, ambiguous Japanese in a noncode identifier.
ICU artifacts or unexpected output characters (Latin letters/combining marks/apostrophe only per converted group).
conventions: Retain native pronunciation spelling through ICU; wo, macrons and apostrophe conventions are not acoustic claims.
gates: Frozen controls and mechanical source/literal preservation first; semantic author/independent review of existing references and reused corpus separately. No default integration or production approval.
